bioconda.name: bioconductor-made4
bioconda.summary: Multivariate analysis of microarray data using ADE4

biotools.summary: Multivariate data analysis and graphical display of microarray data. Functions include for supervised dimension reduction (between group analysis) and joint dimension reduction of 2 datasets (coinertia analysis). It contains functions that require R package ade4.
